notes: Corrected s013/s014: *of* moves from the name into the article's unit. Rule 102's governing precedent, REV.11.15 `τοῦ κυρίου` → *the kingdom of*, gives the article the supplied nominal and the case preposition together and leaves the noun bare, and rule 21 does the same for any article carrying the English determiner. The previous split — *The son* on the article, *of David* on the name — matched neither that precedent nor rule 52's whole-expression-on-the-name reading.
The head stays on the supplied *son* under rule 102, not on *The*.
